source_note: tools/f1_eval_reference.json and the research note 'ForgeInfer - Evaluation Ladder' (values copied from the cited files and pages on 2026-10-10; nothing here is estimated). Metric keys: acc / acc_norm = lm-evaluation-harness definitions (acc_norm divides the log-likelihood by the characters of the continuation); x = the source does not say which one (shown with a star); ppl = LAMBADA word perplexity. Rows are zero-shot unless the note says otherwise.

legend.P: EleutherAI/pythia GitHub repository, evals/ folder: lm-evaluation-harness results of the released checkpoints, 0-shot (old harness, task version 0); files evals/pythia-v1/pythia-160m/zero-shot/160m_step<N>.json and evals/opt/opt-125m.json
legend.M: Liu et al. 2024, MobileLLM (arXiv 2402.14905) Table 3 and the facebook/MobileLLM-125M model card: zero-shot common sense reasoning, baselines evaluated by the authors from their Hugging Face checkpoints; harness, metric and normalisation are not stated
legend.S: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M model card (base model table): 'all evaluations are zero-shot unless stated otherwise, and we use lighteval'; metric and normalisation not stated; ARC is the average of Easy and Challenge
legend.C: Dey et al. 2023, Cerebras-GPT (arXiv 2304.03208) Tables 3 and 8 (same values), EleutherAI evaluation harness, 0-shot, accuracy from token-level probability (no length normalisation)
legend.G: GPT-2 124M: lm-evaluation-harness lambada_openai 0-shot run quoted in Hugging Face discussion openai-community/gpt2 #90 (hf-causal-experimental, task version 0); OpenAI GPT-2 paper values for the same task are LAMBADA ppl 35.13 / acc 45.99 under the paper's own protocol
legend.O: allenai/OLMo-1B-hf model card table (1B-class anchors; the evaluation protocol is described in the OLMo paper, arXiv 2402.00838, not on the card)
legend.H: measured with tools/f1_eval_hf_ref.py on the ladder files (same prompts, same shuffled subsample as the Forge-1 evaluators), CPU, float32; n is in the note
